description: This file defines API endpoints for managing team members in a FastAPI application, including listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting team members.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: FastAPI's class for creating route groups.

classes.name: HTTPException
classes.description: FastAPI exception class for HTTP errors.

classes.name: Session
classes.description: SQLModel session class for database interactions.

classes.name: TeamRepository
classes.description: Repository class handling database operations for team members.

methods.name: list_team(session: Session = Depends(get_session))
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all team members.

methods.name: create_member(payload: TeamMemberCreate, session: Session = Depends(get_session))
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new team member.

methods.name: get_member(member_id: int, session: Session = Depends(get_session))
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific team member by ID.

methods.name: update_member(member_id: int, payload: TeamMemberUpdate, session: Session = Depends(get_session))
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update a team member by ID.

methods.name: delete_member(member_id: int, session: Session = Depends(get_session))
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a team member by ID.
